newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best reviews Transport Life rating.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best reviews Transport Life rating.

text.p: Insurance rating agency A.M. Best said on Monday that it placed the "A-" or "excellent" rating of Transport Life Insurance Co under review with developing implications.
The action followed Conseco Inc's announcement of its intention to buy the holding company, Transport Holdings Inc, for about $311 million, the agency said in a statement.

A.M. Best said that Conseco would continue to benefit from unit cost improvements, through integrating this transaction and previously announced acquisitions of American Travellers Corp and Capitol American Financial Corp.

The agency said it also expected benefits from expanded distribution capacity and increased cross-selling opportunities. A more diversified product portfolio should generate more balanced and predictable revenue and earnings source, it said.

Given the strategic benefits expected to arise from Conseco's acquisition of Transport Holdings, A.M. Best said it was reviewing its "B+" rating of Continental Life Insurance Co, which is owned by Transport Life.
The Transport Holdings purchase would make the combined Conseco companies a major provider of supplemental health insurance, A.M. Best said.
